name: Tray to desk support plane

coordinate_frame.origin: centre of the flat printed underside

datums.description: flat printed underside, also the build-plate seat

constrained: tipping while coins are swept in

assembly.sequence_notes: Dry flat indoor surfaces only; the flat underside is the support-free print seat.

uncontrolled: loaded coin mass and its distribution

keepouts_and_access: No anti-slip claim from geometry alone.

loads_and_performance.host_load: loose coins only; no tension or impact

evidence.uncertainty_note: The flat seat is a CAD-owned design decision; no mass, centre of gravity or desk friction has been measured.

failure_modes.mode: The tray slides or tips while coins are swept in from a pocket.
failure_modes.effect: Coins scatter; the product is worse than no product.
failure_modes.mitigation: Keep the footprint wide and the walls low; verify a 10-degree tilt fully loaded.

acceptance_criteria: With every recess loaded the tray remains upright after a 10-degree tilt.
The tray does not slide during a one-handed pocket sweep.
